nodes.name: 2B - Apollo Person Hydration
nodes.notes: Hydrates the already-resolved Apollo person using the People Enrichment endpoint POST /people/match with Apollo person id. Uses the same people_match-capable credential path as exact-email enrichment; avoids requiring separate person_read / people/show access.

nodes.name: 2B - Profile Anchor Missing?
nodes.notes: Runs the public-web fallback only when Apollo matched the person but neither exact-email match nor hydration produced a LinkedIn profile URL.

nodes.name: 2B - Build Missing Anchor Search
nodes.notes: Builds a narrow Tavily query for a LinkedIn /in/ profile using the already-resolved exact-email identity and confirmed account company.

nodes.name: 2B - Tavily Missing Anchor Search
nodes.notes: One bounded search call. Failure is non-fatal: unresolved/ambiguous anchors continue with linkedin_url=null and Layer 2C will send the case to manual review.

nodes.name: 2B - Resolve Missing Anchor
nodes.notes: Accepts exactly one unique linkedin.com/in candidate only when both resolved-name evidence and confirmed-company evidence corroborate it. Otherwise leaves the anchor missing.
